subject: Request: SDLC proof matrix + pipeline gating artifacts
messages:
From: Emily Park <epark@northbridge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@northbridge.com
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDLC proof matrix + pipeline gating artifacts

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this. Northbridge is running a focused SIG/SOC-2 evidence refresh for platform change controls and CI/CD gating. Can you provide the following artifacts scoped to the inference-serving repo and the infra pipelines used to deploy models?

- A short mapping (matrix) that points to evidence for: code review policy, branch protections, mandatory PR checks, signed commits, and release approvals.
- A snapshot (screenshots/export) of the pipeline gating rules for merge/deploy (e.g., required jobs, rejection reasons).
- A brief note on how secrets are provisioned to runners and whether ephemeral credentials are used.
- Any audit logs/list of PR approvals for the last 90 days for the model-serving repo (redacted where required).

We don't need full logs immediately — pointers and a matrix are fine; we'll request follow-ups if necessary. Target date: next Wednesday 2028-04-18 EOD.

Best,
Emily Park
Senior Auditor, Northbridge Capital

[Attachment: initial_questionnaire.pdf (stub)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <epark@northbridge.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC proof matrix + pipeline gating artifacts

Thanks Emily — looping in Monica (security ops) and Karthik (platform infra) for evidence pull. Monica/Karthik, can you own the artifact collection and deliver a single zipped package + a short mapping doc by 2028-04-18 EOD? Priorities: code review matrix (where each control maps to a file or URL), pipeline gating snapshot, and PR approval list for the last 90 days.

Notes for the pack: redact commit bodies that include secrets or personal data; the auditor is fine with redacted PR metadata. Also include a short statement about secrets provisioning (Vault ephemeral tokens vs long-lived env vars).

I'll coordinate delivery and send to Emily once we have everything.

- Sean
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Emily Park <epark@northbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC proof matrix + pipeline gating artifacts

Sean / team — taking point. Quick status and plan:

- Code review matrix: I created a mapping doc that links each control to an evidence item (file, Confluence page, or pipeline screenshot). See attached code_review_matrix_v1.pdf.
- Pipeline gating snapshot: exported the deploy pipeline job settings and included a visual exported PNG (pipeline_gating_snapshot.png). The snapshot shows required checks: unit-tests, integration-tests, signed-image-scan, and mandatory manual approval for production.
- Secrets provisioning: short statement included in the matrix (we use HashiCorp Vault with short-lived AppRole tokens for runners; KMS-wrapped static creds only for legacy batch jobs).
- PR approvals: extracted PR approval events into pr-approval-log.csv with approver usernames and timestamps; redacted descriptions with PII.

Two open items: 1) Karthik, can you confirm the commit signing policy and provide the signed-commit proof query output (SHA list) so we can attach it? 2) Soojin, can you include the change-management approval artifact for the most recent canary rollout (runbook sign-off)?

Deliverables attached: code_review_matrix_v1.pdf, pipeline_gating_snapshot.png, pr-approval-log.csv. I'll bundle sig-sdlc-answers-2028.xlsx with any additional notes we get.

Thanks,
Monica
Security Operations Manager
[Attachments: code_review_matrix_v1.pdf, pipeline_gating_snapshot.png, pr-approval-log.csv]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Emily Park <epark@northbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC proof matrix + pipeline gating artifacts

Monica — FYI I ran the signed-commit query against the repo and exported the matching SHAs. I included a short explanation in the matrix (commit-signing enforced via branch-protection + required GPG signature check in CI). For CI gating: our YAML gating job fails the merge if signatures don't validate or if required approvals aren't present.

Regarding secrets: vault-agent with AppRole issues short-lived tokens to runners; we rotate the root AppRole role-id every 30 days. For legacy jobs that still use long-lived KMS-wrapped creds, we added a ticket (INFRA-3421) and a deprecation timeline to phase them out by Q3.

Attached: sig-sdlc-answers-2028.xlsx (answers + queries), and a small export of the commit SHAs (attached as signed-shas.txt inside the zip I will produce).

-Karthik
Senior Staff Engineer, Platform
[Attachments: sig-sdlc-answers-2028.xlsx]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <epark@northbridge.com>, Northbridge Audit Team <audit@northbridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverable: SDLC proof matrix + pipeline gating artifacts (Northbridge request)

Emily / team — thank you for the patience. Per your request, attached is the SDLC evidence bundle scoped to the inference-serving repo and deploy pipelines:

Attachments (zipped bundle):
- sdlc_evidence_bundle_20280420.zip (contains the following stubs):
  - code_review_matrix_v1.pdf (control-to-evidence mapping)
  - pipeline_gating_snapshot.png (pipeline gating export)
  - pr-approval-log.csv (last 90 days, redacted)
  - sig-sdlc-answers-2028.xlsx (Q&A and verification queries)
  - signed-shas.txt (list of signed commit SHAs)

Quick summary of controls:
- Code review: enforced via protected branches (+ required reviews = 2), changelog and templated PRs, automated lint + unit + integration checks in CI. Evidence: matrix points to Confluence policy + PR templates + sample PRs.
- CI/CD gating: pipeline prevents merge on failing checks; production deploys require a manual approval step and a successful canary (automated smoke tests).
- Secrets: HashiCorp Vault AppRole -> short-lived tokens to runners; dynamic credentials for cloud APIs; legacy KMS-wrapped keys scheduled for deprecation (INFRA-3421).
- Change management: runbook sign-offs captured in our CM tool and linked in the matrix; emergency change process documented and audited.

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/s/SDLC-ProofMatrix-2028, JIRA INFRA-3421, Confluence page attached above.

If you want full raw logs for any of the items, please specify which exports you'd like and we'll coordinate secure delivery (SFTP or a secure upload portal).

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: sdlc_evidence_bundle_20280420.zip]
